Print now asks what to print: the whole plan, what’s on the screen, or one bed, either the bed you’ve selected or one picked from the list. Each is drawn as big as fits on the page, at a scale you can check with a ruler, on a page turned the way that suits it.
Printing what’s on the screen or one bed, the plant list has only the plants in it, numbered as they are on the whole plan’s printout, and the page says what it shows, such as “Front bed: 7 plants”.
The whole plan prints bigger where it can, too: there are more scales to choose from between the old ones, such as 1 in = 6 ft.

Export image offers the same choice and frames the same part of the plan: one bed comes out big, and what’s on the screen comes out at the size you see it. The choice is kept, for Print and pictures alike, until the app is closed.
